name: Agents
description: Runs custom agents (GitHub #127): small graphs made on the Canvas and saved as one file, data/agents/<id>.vertep-agent.json. After a reply the agents a chat uses (its preset, or its own copy) read the chat, ask a model what they need to, keep their own state and numbers (data/agents/state/<chatId>/<agent>.json) and leave notes, buttons or a hint for the next reply. A file is checked before it is installed, and an agent runs only with the permissions the user confirmed.
